capture: Visible assistant answer text and DOM hrefs. No clipboard text, private history, hidden state or API payload used.

default.mode: Fresh normal conversation, same prompt requesting web search; actual retrieval traces not verified.
default.required_claims: Seven requested atomic facts match independently checked primary references.

explicit_search.mode: Fresh conversation; Add > Web search selected and search chip confirmed before submitting same question text.
explicit_search.required_claims: Seven requested atomic facts match independently checked primary references.
explicit_search.extra_review: The sentence saying July20 is not the first-step date needs timezone/source clarification; the cited NASA page gives launch/landing/return timestamps but no first-step date. Do not call the entire answer false.

scope: Two ChatGPT runs. Anonymous and signed-in Perplexity attempts are retained separately. Paid plans, model IDs, internal retrieval traces and latency were not benchmarked.
